jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Sr. Product Manager
Job Description
We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver the latest technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of develop, build and run the future of Integrated Services.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures. About the Role
Concentrix is seeking a Product Manager to drive the strategy, execution, and commercial growth of Memory — our agentic intelligence engine that powers smarter, more personalized customer experiences across the iX Suite.

Memory is a foundational capability within the iX platform, enabling real-time customer understanding through living Memory Cards, dynamic identity resolution, and predictive intent modeling. It serves as the intelligence layer that makes every interaction across iX Hello and iX Hero smarter, faster, and more profitable.

You will operate as a recognized product expert, accountable for translating commercial targets into a focused roadmap and ensuring every feature and improvement delivered moves the needle on adoption, retention, and revenue. You will work across Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to solve complex product problems and guide the team toward measurable outcomes.

What You'll Own
Product Vision & Roadmap Execution
- Drive the product roadmap for Memory, translating strategic direction into a prioritized, outcome-focused plan
- Define how identity resolution, Memory Cards, intent modeling, and action delivery function as a cohesive capability; not a point solution
- Identify and develop new product concepts where limited precedent exists

Commercial Contribution & Business Alignment
- Contribute to revenue target setting and ensure the roadmap and delivered features are aligned to commercial goals
- Partner with Sales, Finance, and Product Marketing to inform pricing, packaging, and monetization discussions
- Make focused trade-off decisions across scope, cost, and timing to maximize product value

Trust, Compliance & Enterprise Readiness
- Ensure iX Wisdom Memory meets enterprise-grade requirements
- Balance speed of innovation with responsible AI and risk management
- Ensure strong alignment with integrated products (e.g., iX Hello, iX Hero, Translate)

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence
- Collaborate and influence across Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Security, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success
- Serve as a recognized subject matter expert for Memory and agentic intelligence within the organization and with clients

Team Development
- Guide and develop junior product team members, sharing expertise and raising the quality of product thinking
- Coordinate activities across team members on complex projects and new assignments

What We're Looking For
Experience & Background
- Typically requires:
- Bachelor's degree with 8–12 years of related experience, or
- Master's degree with 6+ years
- Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise-grade SaaS or AI products with commercial awareness
- Demonstrated success driving roadmap execution and cross-functional delivery in ambiguous environments

Product & Domain Expertise
- Advanced understanding of AI-powered systems, ideally including agentic AI, ML pipelines, real-time data processing, or customer data platforms
- Comfortable developing solutions to complex problems with limited precedent
- Familiarity with enterprise data infrastructure (streaming pipelines, event-driven architectures, multi-tenant platforms) is a plus

Leadership & Influence
- Strong influencing and persuasion skills — able to align diverse stakeholders and adapt messaging to different audiences
- Clear, concise communicator who can convey complex product and technical topics to business stakeholders
- Recognized as an expert and trusted advisor on complex matters within and beyond the immediate team

Why This Role Matters
- Commercial Impact: You directly contribute to revenue targets and ensure the product delivers against business goals
- Platform Leverage: Memory is the intelligence engine powering the entire iX Suite. Every Hello and Hero interaction depends on it
- AI at Scale: Your decisions shape how Concentrix delivers agentic, predictive intelligence across global CX operations
- Growth Opportunity: This role positions you at the center of Concentrix's most strategically differentiated AI capability

Ideal Candidate Profile
You are a product leader who:
- Thinks in outcomes, not features
- Brings deep expertise and uses it to guide and elevate those around you
- Balances customer value, business performance, and technical reality
- Thrives in complexity, adapts quickly, and delivers with clarity and accountability

Location:
RON Work- at -Home
Language Requirements:
English (Required)
Time Type:
Full time

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Voice of Customer
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Senior Product Marketing Manager - Voice of Customer
Job Description
We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Concentrix is redefining the future of Voice of Customer (VOC). As the market evolves beyond surveys and measurement, organizations need new ways to unify customer signals, generate actionable insights, and drive business value through AI, analytics, and operational action.
We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help shape and communicate this vision to the market while enabling growth across sales, account management, product, and client success teams.
This role sits at the center of our go-to-market strategy, connecting market trends, product innovation, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and content development to drive awareness, pipeline growth, and client adoption.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational execution and is equally comfortable developing positioning, building executive-ready content, managing product launches, enabling sellers, and leveraging AI-powered tools to scale marketing impact.

What you will do in this role
In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

Product & Solution Positioning
·       Develop messaging, positioning, and value propositions for our VOC and CX solutions.
·       Translate complex platform capabilities and services into compelling business narratives.
·       Maintain competitive positioning against platform providers and emerging AI-enabled customer intelligence solutions.
·       Partner with product leaders to articulate roadmap investments and innovation stories.

Go-to-Market Strategy
·       Support launch planning for platform enhancements, new offerings, and strategic initiatives.
·       Develop campaign themes, buyer journeys, and audience-specific messaging frameworks.
·       Partner with growth marketing and demand generation teams to align campaigns with product priorities.
·       Collaborate with sales leadership to ensure GTM motions support revenue objectives.

Sales Enablement & Solutioning
·       Create and maintain sales materials including:
o   First-strike presentations
o   Solution overviews
o   Competitive battlecards
o   Proposal content
o   Case studies
o   Executive briefing materials
·       Support strategic pursuits with tailored messaging and value articulation.
·       Partner with account teams to identify and scale best practices across client engagements.

Content Strategy & Knowledge Management
·       Develop a scalable content architecture that supports marketing, sales, and client-facing teams.
·       Own the lifecycle of core product marketing assets from creation through adoption.
·       Leverage AI-powered knowledge management tools to improve content discovery, reuse, and productivity.
·       Establish processes that transform subject matter expertise into repeatable commercial assets.

Market Intelligence & Thought Leadership
·       Monitor market trends across VOC, CX, AI, analytics, customer intelligence, and experience management.
·       Conduct competitive analysis and deliver insights to leadership and go-to-market teams.
·       Help develop thought leadership content that positions Concentrix as a leader in the evolving customer intelligence market.
·       Support analyst engagement and industry benchmarking initiatives.

Performance & Optimization
·       Measure adoption and effectiveness of sales enablement and product marketing assets.
·       Track content utilization, campaign performance, and commercial impact.
·       Continuously improve messaging and enablement based on market feedback and performance insights.

Your qualifications
We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.
Concentrix is a great match if you have:

·       5+ years of experience in product marketing, solution marketing, product management, or go-to-market strategy.
·       Experience marketing SaaS, technology-enabled services, CX, VOC, analytics, AI, or customer intelligence solutions.
·       Proven ability to develop messaging, positioning, and executive-level content.
·       Strong presentation and storytelling skills.
·       Experience supporting enterprise sales organizations and complex B2B buying cycles.
·       Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with product, sales, marketing, and operations teams.
·       Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications
·       Experience within VOC, Customer Experience, Experience Management, Market Research, Contact Center, or Customer Intelligence industries.
·       Experience implementing or leveraging AI-powered content, enablement, or knowledge management solutions.
·       Experience supporting analyst relations, industry benchmarking, or thought leadership initiatives.

What Success Looks Like
In your first 12 months, you will:
·       Establish a clear market narrative for our evolving customer intelligence portfolio.
·       Create a scalable library of high-impact sales and marketing assets.
·       Improve sales readiness and consistency of solution messaging.
·       Support successful launches of key platform innovations.
·       Increase content utilization and enablement effectiveness through AI-powered knowledge management.
·       Strengthen our position as a differentiated provider of both technology and strategic services.

What’s in it for you
We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.
In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:
-   Full time position
-   Remote working
-   Competitive Salary

The base salary range for this position is $86,000 - $108,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.
The deadline for applying for this position is: October 30th, 2026 . This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

As part of the hiring process, candidates may be required to undergo background screening and identity verification, where permitted by applicable law and consistent with the requirements of the role.  Certain verification processes used by the Company or its service providers may involve technologies that rely on biometric identifiers or biometric information, where permitted by law.  If biometric identifiers or biometric information are collected, used, or stored, the Company will provide the legally required disclosures and obtain any required written consent prior to such collection, and will handle such information in accordance with applicable biometric privacy laws and Company policies.
